name: Merchant Reputation
description: Rule mod: truthful inspections raise reputation +1, getting caught with contraband lowers it -1 (mismatched legal goods do NOT cost reputation). Reputation biases deck draws: positive reputation draws more legal cards (gradient, ~90% at rep 5), negative reputation draws more contraband (capped ~70%, leaving room to recover). Perks at 1/3/5: +1 market discard, -10% fines, refill to 7 cards.
description_zh: 玩法模组：查实说真话声望 +1，被查出违禁品声望 -1（仅合法货物与申报不同不扣声望）。声望影响抽牌：正声望抽到合法货概率梯度上升（声望5约90%），负声望抽到违禁品概率上升但封顶约70%，留有翻盘余地。1/3/5 点额外解锁：市场多弃1张、罚金-10%、补牌至7张。
